decisionsTitle: The badge watermark's size, space and place: four numbers in a fold of its own, «Logo-ul clubului (filigran)» (amending §965)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-17, four days before Saturday's race (2026-11-21), designing the volunteers' badges with the watermark just released (§965):** «și practic trebuie să pot seta dimensiunea logo-ului, padding și offset» — and of the choice itself, which sat inside «Locul pentru nume»: «nu văd unde să pun logo». Amends §965, which left out «a choice of where the watermark stands or how large it is», and the designer of §764.

**Decision.**

- **Four whole numbers in the badge's design**, each with its bounds and its default (`BADGE_FOOTER_LOGO_SETTINGS` in `badge-geometry.ts`):
  - `footerLogoSizePct` — «Mărimea logo-ului (% din lățimea ecusonului)»: 10–100, default 67. The logo's widest width is that share of the badge's paper width; its height still follows the lockup's proportion (`LOGO_RATIO`), and it still shrinks to fit the room it is given (below).
  - `footerLogoPaddingMm` — «Spațiu în jurul logo-ului (mm)»: 0–20, default 0. That many millimetres are kept clear between the logo and the edges of its room, on every side, before it is fitted: the space makes it smaller and never moves a row.
  - `footerLogoOffsetXMm` — «Deplasare stânga–dreapta (mm)» — and `footerLogoOffsetYMm` — «Deplasare sus–jos (mm)»: −100…100, default 0; positive is right and down, and the help says so («Pozitiv = mai jos»).

  Each is read forgivingly by the one reader (`readBadgeDesign`): a design saved before them, a value of the wrong type, a fraction or a number out of bounds reads as the default — never refused on read — and the designer says so beside the fold (`badgeDesignDropped`, as it does for §965's level). The save refuses a number that is not whole or not within its bounds, naming its box — every wrong box of the four at once — with every box kept; an empty box is the default, as a form from before the boxes posts none and an empty level is `off`. The preview's address carries the four, so the preview follows the unsaved boxes as they are typed; the event's file carries them under `badges.design`, the import's diff naming each, and so does a copy of the event. Saved and audited as every key of the design is (`event.badge_design_changed`, each key named).
- **The room is the writing area.** By default the logo is where §965 puts it: fitted in the writing area's lower part — from the foot of «Nume:»'s line down to the writing area's foot less half the pad — centred across the badge and standing on that room's foot. The size and the space size it there: the room less the space on every side, and never wider than the size's share of the badge. The two offsets then move it, and last it is kept inside the whole writing area — the white between the role's band, or the free-text line, and the telephone's row or the badge's foot, between the content's sides — less the space. So the club may move it anywhere in the white where the name is written, over «Nume:» too (it is drawn first, so the words go over it), and never over the header, the role's band, the free-text line or the telephone's row. It still takes no height: no row moves, and `badgeRows` and the save's fit check (`badgeSizeRefusal`) are unchanged, so a size that fits without the logo fits with it at every setting. Why the writing area and no more: it is the white the watermark is for — a band or a row under it would put the logo behind words that must read — and the room under «Nume:» still decides how large it can be, §965's reason, so a short strip keeps a logo the marker writes over. Measured: on the default 90 × 35 mm strip the room under «Nume:» decides (21.7 mm wide), so a larger size draws the same and a smaller one less; on a tall badge the size decides — on 90 × 287 mm, 9 mm at 10 %, 60 mm at 67 % and the whole width between the sides, 86 mm, at 100 %. The space makes the logo smaller where its room holds it — on the default strip each millimetre takes two from the room's height, and 5 mm leave no room, so no logo, never one over «Nume:» — and where the logo stands well inside its room the space keeps it that far from the edges, shrinking it only once it reaches them.
- **One box.** `badgeFooterLogoBox` in `badge-geometry.ts` still computes it, now with the four as its `placement`, and `badgeLayout` hands it the design's own: the sheet (`badges-pdf.ts`), the picture (`badge-image.tsx`, through the preview route) and so the print panel's pictures draw the same box. Tested at every width and height step of 10 mm the bounds allow and the tallest, with every set of rows a club may tick, at sizes 10, 67 and 100 %, spaces 0 and 20 mm and each move at ±100 mm: inside the writing area less the space, over no band and no row, the rest of the layout identical; the PDF's call and the picture's markup read back into the same box.
- **At the defaults every badge is §965's, byte for byte.** 67 % is §965's two thirds: no whole percent says it exactly, so the default is read as two thirds (`badgeFooterLogoWidthShare`) and any other percent as itself; then no space, no move, and a box the writing area never has to stop. Held by `tests/unit/volunteers/badge-type-unchanged.test.ts` and its snapshot `badge-drawing-before-logo-controls.json`, written by that test from the code before the four settings (baseline `BR-V4.56-2026-11-17`, with the taller badges): every case at each level — the layout, the picture's markup and the sheet's calls — and the box alone on every size the bounds allow in steps of 10 mm, drawn again with the four spelled out at their defaults and as stored without them. Why: a badge designed and printed before the race stays the same badge until the club moves its logo. `BADGE_DRAWING_VERSION` is 4, so every picture's address changes.
- **A fold of its own.** «Logo-ul clubului jos, ca filigran» leaves «Locul pentru nume» for a fold right after it, «Logo-ul clubului (filigran)», with the house's glyph for a picture and a closed line that says the level and, while the logo is drawn, its size — «Mediu · 67%», «Fără» while it is off. Inside: the level's select as before, then the four native number boxes (whole steps within the bounds, the phone's numeric keyboard), two side by side on a computer and one under the other on a phone, each with one short help line. They are always enabled and always posted, «Fără» included. «Locul pentru nume»'s closed line no longer names the logo.

**Not done (each its own change, when asked).** Another picture than the club's lockup (a sponsor's, the event's); the header's logo; rotating the logo; the race numbers (bibs); a logo larger than its room under «Nume:» when it is moved up; a size or a place per role.
changelogLine: - **The badges' logo, sized and placed by the club** — on the volunteers' badges page, «Logo-ul clubului (filigran)» is a section of its own, after «Locul pentru nume», with the logo's size (% of the badge's width), the space kept around it and two moves, left–right and up–down, in millimetres; the logo always stays in the white area of the name, the preview follows as you type, and a badge left at the defaults prints exactly as before. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Cum arată ecusonul», then «Logo-ul clubului (filigran)» is a fold of its own right after «Locul pentru nume» — which no longer holds the logo's select nor names the logo in its closed line (amending criterion 256) — with the picture's glyph, a closed line naming the level and, while the logo is drawn, its size («Mediu · 67%»), and inside the level's select and four native number boxes in whole steps, always enabled: «Mărimea logo-ului (% din lățimea ecusonului)» 10–100, «Spațiu în jurul logo-ului (mm)» 0–20, «Deplasare stânga–dreapta (mm)» and «Deplasare sus–jos (mm)» −100…100, each with one help line, in Romanian and English; the preview follows the unsaved boxes (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badges-page-render.test.ts`, `volunteers/badge-footer-logo-controls.test.ts`.

Given «Salvează ecusonul», then the four numbers are kept in `events.badge_design` as `footerLogoSizePct` (default 67), `footerLogoPaddingMm` (default 0), `footerLogoOffsetXMm` and `footerLogoOffsetYMm` (default 0), each key changed audited by name; a number that is not whole or not within its bounds is refused naming its box — every wrong box at once — with every box kept, and an empty box is the default; a design stored or an event file made before them, a value of the wrong type and a number out of bounds read as the default, named beside the fold and never a throw; the four travel in the event's file under `badges.design`, the diff naming each, and in a copy of the event (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badge-footer-logo-controls.test.ts`, integration `volunteers/badges.test.ts`.

Given a badge design with a level chosen, then the club's lockup is fitted in the writing area's lower part under «Nume:»'s line less the space on every side, never wider than the size's share of the badge's width (67 % being two thirds), moved by the offsets with right and down positive, and kept inside the whole writing area less the space — never over the header, the role's band, the free-text line or the telephone's row — at every size the bounds allow, with every set of rows, at sizes 10, 67 and 100 %, spaces 0 and 20 mm and moves of ±100 mm; no row moves, the save answers every size as it does without the logo, and the PDF sheet, the picture and the print panel's pictures draw the same box (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badge-footer-logo-controls.test.ts`.

Given a badge design whose four numbers are at their defaults — spelled out, or absent from a design stored before them — then every badge prints exactly what it printed before them at every level: the same layout, the same picture and the same calls to the PDF; the drawing's version is 4, so every picture's address changes (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badge-type-unchanged.test.ts`.

batchLine: the badges' watermark sized and placed by the club, in a fold of its own
